learning_outcomes.text: Explain how private keys, public keys and addresses relate
Describe seed phrases, derivation paths and HD wallets
Compare hot, cold, hardware and multisig wallet options
Reason about transaction signing and approval safety
Identify common theft and social-engineering attack vectors
Design a practical key-management and recovery plan

integrative_case: A small startup will hold company crypto funds and let three employees transact; design a key-management plan covering wallet types, multisig approvals, signing hygiene and recovery, and explain the theft vectors each control mitigates.
